content.comment_body: I am using threshold detectors (Detector de Umbral in Spanish) with a [company_name] [product_name]. In simulation, everything works correctly for me. However, when I transfer the program to the device, the detectors do not function as expected. During online testing, the clock does not operate and the time does not count up. I have attached an image for reference.

You can only view the running time during simulation. When using the Online Test, you will only see the sum of the counted pulses. To view this sum, place your cursor over the block. A glasses icon will appear on the right side of the block—click on it, and an output field will open displaying the value.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that threshold detectors configured in [product_name] software simulate correctly but do not behave the same way after deploying to the actual [company_name] controller. Specifically, the timer for the count does not run during online testing. Another user clarifies that in real device online testing, running time feedback is not available as in simulation; only pulse totals are visible using the block's glasses icon.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the simulation results for time counting in threshold detectors to match real-world operation, enabling direct verification of the running time during online testing on the device.
